scripts.title: Frost Menu OP
scripts.features:
Combat Tab
Aimbot (left side):

Enable Aimbot (toggle)
Visibility Check (toggle)
FOV slider (10–500)
Smoothness slider (1–50)
Triggerbot (right side):

Enable Triggerbot (toggle)
Team Check (toggle, default on)
Visibility Check (toggle)
Shoot Through Wood (toggle, default on)
FOV slider (10–200)
Delay slider (0–500ms)
Hit Part dropdown (Head / HumanoidRootPart / UpperTorso)
Visuals Tab
Visuals (single left section):

Enable Visuals (toggle)
Box ESP (toggle)
Skeleton ESP (toggle)
Name Tag (toggle)
Weapon ESP (toggle)
Health Bar (toggle)
Health Text (toggle)
Tracer (toggle)
Distance (toggle)
Team Check (toggle)
Wall Check (toggle)
Box Fill Transparency slider (0–10)
Skeleton Thickness slider (1–5)
Max Distance slider (100–5000)
Text Size slider (8–20)
Tracer Origin dropdown (Bottom / Center / Mouse / Top)
Ally Color colorpicker
Enemy Color colorpicker
Optic Color colorpicker
Optic Transparency slider (0–10)
Misc Tab
Misc (left side):

Give Admin [Client Sided] (toggle)
Spoof KD / Spoof Kills / Spoof Ping / Spoof Wins (toggles)
Spin Bot (toggle)
Force Third Person (toggle)
Teleport Everyone In Front (toggle)
Velocity Fly [Risk] (toggle)
NoClip [Risk] (toggle)
Walk Speed [Risk] (toggle)
Fly Speed slider (10–300)
Walk Speed slider (16–200)
Spin Speed slider (10–300)
KD Value slider (0–999)
Kills Value slider (0–99999)
Ping Value slider (1–500)
Wins Value slider (0–99999)
Gun Mods (right side):

No Recoil (toggle)
No Spread (toggle)
Instant Reload (toggle)
Rapid Fire (toggle)
Fire Rate slider (1–100)
Player FOV slider (50–120)
